name: Pacific & Indian cyclones
summary: GDACS red alert as Cyclone Murasu heads for Andhra Pradesh landfall on 3 Nov
state: GDACS raised a red alert on 1 Nov for the Bay of Bengal system FOUR-26, now named Cyclone Murasu. IMD expects it to become a severe cyclonic storm and cross the south Andhra Pradesh coast between Nellore and Narsapur by the morning of 3 Nov, with winds of 100–110 km/h gusting to 120 km/h. Typhoon In-Fa near Japan remains at green alert.
for_you: If you are in or travelling to coastal Andhra Pradesh or Odisha, follow IMD and local authority warnings and FCDO travel advice. Expect flight and rail disruption around landfall.
rubric_hit: GDACS red cyclone alert, or a super-typhoon/severe cyclone landfall on a populated coast.
